title: HAI SHOR JIN-O-BASHAR ME PAIHAM MALAK BHI AANSU BAHA RAHE HAI
body:
HAI SHOR JIN-O-BASHAR ME PAIHAM MALAK BHI AANSU BAHA RAHE HAI
HUSSAIN KU KARBALA ME ZALIM LAAHU KE AANSU BAHA RAHE HAI
1.Jigar Ko Thame Hai Anbiya Bhi Ajeeb Manzar Hai Karbala Me
Gul-e-Shahadat Se Ibne Zehra Zameen-e-Karbal Sajara Rahe Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
2.Kahan Ho Ayub Aakey Dekho Pidar Ke Kandhe Pe Laashe Akber
Zayeef Todhti Kamar Ku Kas Ke Jawan Ka Laasha Utha Rahe Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
3.Khadi Hai Dewdi Ke Dar Pe Laila Nazar Jhukaye Jigar Ko Thame
Jawan Bete Ki Laash Utha Ke Hussain Maqtal Se Aarahe Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
4.Sakina Kehti Hai Ro Ke Baba Sulalo Seene Pe Mujh Ku Apne
Na Aaya Wapis Koi Bhi Abtak Jo Run Ko Qaime Se Jarahe Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
5.Hai Aale-e-Ahmed Me Taza Maishar Kaleja Pakdhe Khadi Hai Zainab
Chadha Ke Naize Pe Farq-e-Sarwar Laiyeen Khushiyan Mana Rahe Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
6.Hai Loot Qaimou Me Shah-eDeen Ke Nazar Me Har Su Dhuwa Dhuwa Ha
Kisi Ki Masnath Kisi Ka Bistar Kisi Ka Jhoola Jaala Rahe Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
7.Hussain Ro Ro Ke Sun Rahe Hai Yeh Karwan-e-Aza Se Nouha
Tumhara Nouha Haram Me Mazhar Tadhap Ke Mehdi Suna Rahe Hai
